query:
SELECT e.id, e.nome, e.slug, e.tenantId, c.id as cat_id, c.nome as cat_nome, c.ordem, c.ativo
FROM empresas e
LEFT JOIN categorias c ON c.empresaSlug = e.slug
WHERE e.nome LIKE '%eraphine%' OR e.slug LIKE '%eraphine%'
ORDER BY e.id, c.ordem;
